title: Cup Left of the Laptop
tests: Whether the output preserves explicit viewer-relative spatial relationships and object attributes.

judge.summary: A clean, wide overhead illustration shows a centered open laptop, a yellow cup on the left, and a closed blue notebook on the right, with clear spacing and no text.

must_haves.item: The desk is illustrated from a top-down viewpoint in a 16:9 frame.
must_haves.why: The desk arrangement is shown from above in a wide frame consistent with 16:9.

must_haves.item: An open laptop sits in the middle of the composition.
must_haves.why: The open laptop occupies the center, with its blank screen and keyboard visible.

must_haves.item: A yellow cup is visibly to the viewer's left of the laptop.
must_haves.why: A yellow cup sits clearly to the left of the laptop.

must_haves.item: A closed blue notebook is visibly to the viewer's right of the laptop.
must_haves.why: A closed blue notebook sits clearly to the right of the laptop.

must_haves.item: Visible desk surface separates the cup, laptop, and notebook; none overlaps another.
must_haves.why: Clear bands of desk surface separate all three objects.

must_haves.item: No text appears on the screen, notebook, or elsewhere.
must_haves.why: The screen and notebook are blank, and the keyboard has no visible lettering.
